items.text: Chirevo pamusoro peNinevhe. Bhuku rezvakaonekwa naNahumi muErikoshi.
Jehovha ane godo uye ndiMwari anotsiva;
uye anochengetera vavengi vake hasha dzake.
Jehovha anononoka kutsamwa uye ane simba guru;
Jehovha haangasiye ane mhosva asina kurangwa.
uye makore ndiwo guruva retsoka dzake.
pane mumwe akabuda anoronga zvakaipa pamusoro paJehovha
Zvino ndichavhuna joko ravo kubva pamutsipa wako
Jehovha arayira shoko pamusoro pako, iwe Ninevhe, rokuti,

uye munondo uchaparadza shumba dzenyu duku.

items.text: Zvose izvi nokuda kwokuchiva kuzhinji kwechifeve,
"Ndine mhaka newe," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha Wamasimba Ose.
Ndichafukura nguo yako ifukidze chiso chako
Etiopia neIjipiti ndizvo zvaiva simba rayo guru;
Puti neRibhiya dzaiva pakati pavabatsiri vayo.
Nhare dzako dzose dzafanana nemiti yemionde
asi kana zuva rabuda dzinobhururuka dzichienda,
Iwe mambo weAsiria, vafudzi vako vanotsumwaira;
machinda ako anorara pasi kuti azorore.
